name: body
title: The body: bow, sear and trigger printed in place, the magazine column and the barrel, on an optimised frame
orientation: Flat on the bed on its bed wall, the lid side up, as the optimiser laid it out: every flexure bends within its layers. The sled drops into the slot from the lid side, its tab into the gap behind the trigger; the magazine insert goes in from the top; the lid snaps on.

width.rule: Every flexure's height off the bed

wall.rule: The base everything stands on: the body's bed wall

slot.rule: The barrel slot's height: the disc and a fit each side

body_z.rule: The slot's walls' height off the bed: the lid sits on them

travel.rule: How far the bow is drawn: 0 at rest, launcher.travel when cocked

travel_max.rule: The full draw the leaf is sized for

overrun.rule: The sled's rest is this far ahead of the leaf's

draw.rule: The leaf's force at full draw

leaf_t.rule: The leaf's thickness, six lines: what the sizing picks for the draw at the travel (the build checks)

max_leaf.rule: The longest leaf allowed: it runs down inside the grip

rest_x.rule: The tab's rear face at rest, ahead of the bead by the overrun

root_block.rule: The block the leaf grows from

overlap.rule: How far parts sink into each other, so they join

bite.rule: How far the leaf's tip reaches up the tab from its bottom: more than the tip drops as it bends, less than the bead's radius covers of the leaf's lean

tip_y.rule: The leaf's tip: the tab's bottom plus the bite

sear_len.rule: The sear's leaf: long enough that the trigger's lift stays under the strain limit

sear_w.rule: The sear's width: from the bed wall to beside the tab's path

undercut.rule: How far the sear's tooth stands into the slot, over the sled's front edge

lead.rule: The tooth's ramp: the sled rides over it when cocked

sear_gap.rule: The sear's leaf below the floor's underside

foot.rule: The foot under the sear's tip, and the shelf it carries back towards the trigger: the trigger's arm fits between the leaf and the shelf

sear_block.rule: The block the sear's leaf grows from

hinge_block.rule: The trigger's arm thickness: it fits between the sear's leaf and its shelf

shelf.rule: The shelf's reach back from the foot

trigger_x.rule: The trigger's pivot ahead of the leaf's rest: its hinge post stands clear of the tab's run, and the leaf bends away from it

finger_arm.rule: From the pivot down to the finger: the finger's travel over this is the hinge's turn

arm_t.rule: The finger arm's thickness along the barrel

hinge_arms.rule: The living hinge's blocks either side of its strip

pull.rule: How far the trigger is pulled: 0 at rest, launcher.trigger_travel when fired

pull_max.rule: The finger's full travel, to the stop

base_back.rule: The base reaches this far behind the leaf: the grip's back wall, which the cocking ring rests against

bead.rule: A round bead along the leaf's tip, the radius of its thickness: the tab is pushed at the tip whatever the leaf's lean, so the draw is the tip's travel

frame.rule: What carries the mechanism: the optimised frame, a plain base plate for the test rig, or nothing (the regions a problem reads)

problem.rule: The frame's optimisation problem, or none for the rig and the regions

leaf_len.rule: The leaf's length: what the sizing gives for the draw at the travel (the build checks it, within half a millimetre), so the grip's bottom is a plain number

grip_bottom.rule: The grip's bottom edge: under the leaf's root block

back.rule: The back of the grip: its wall's outer face, which the cocking ring rests against

wall_t.rule: The back wall and the column walls: the cap's notches are cut into the column walls, leaving a wall behind them

grip_front.rule: The grip's front face: ahead of the leaf's rest with a strap's worth of wall, behind the trigger's swing

guard_bottom.rule: The trigger guard's bottom edge: under the finger's travel

guard_front.rule: The trigger guard's front: room for a finger ahead of the trigger

receiver_bottom.rule: The receiver's underside ahead of the guard: under the sear's pocket

muzzle.rule: The barrel's end: the disc's centre is 8 mm short of it when the sled stops

barrel_h.rule: The barrel's half-height past the column

top.rule: The receiver's top edge, the column walls' top: the insert's cap stands above it

tooth_back.value: bead - travel_max + sled.reach + sled.length + sled.nose + fit
tooth_back.rule: The sear tooth's holding face: a fit ahead of the sled's nose when cocked

col0.rule: The column's rear wall, inner face: the mouth starts a fit ahead of the tooth, the ledge behind that

col1.rule: The column's front wall, inner face: the follower and a fit each side

notch_y.rule: The bottom of the notches the cap's barbs snap into: a fit under the hooks' tips with the cap pressed home

notch_h.rule: The notches' height: the barbs' lead, flat and back, with room

pin_depth.rule: The sockets' holes' depth: the pins' shafts, so the barbs click out below

pin_a.rule: The sockets: one at each corner of the grip's bottom, one at the top rear, one under the receiver's front. Their x, then their y

pin_d.rule: Front socket, x: under the receiver, ahead of the sear

cap_bottom.value: sled.thickness / 2 + launcher.capacity * launcher.disc_t + magazine.follower + magazine.thickness + (magazine.turns - 1) * magazine.pitch - magazine.preload - magazine.stroke - magazine.overlap
cap_bottom.rule: The insert's cap, its underside, pressed home over a full stack resting on the sled

strap.rule: The grip's front and back straps, where the hand holds: the optimiser's supports

knock_len.rule: The muzzle's end, where a knock lands

pin_lip.rule: The lid's pins' barbs, past the pin

pin_room.rule: The cavity under each socket's hole, where the barb clicks out

grid.rule: The frame problem's cell (problems/frame.json says the same): the outside region stays two cells clear of the outline, so no node the part uses is fixed

body.label: The body, printed as one piece

mounts.label: What the optimiser must keep: the bed wall and everything the flexures are fixed to (the regions variant)

pockets.label: What the optimiser must leave empty: the flexures' sweeps, the slot, the column, the trigger's room (the regions variant)

space.label: Where the optimiser may put material: the body's outline (the regions variant)

straps.label: The grip's front and back straps, where the hand holds: the optimiser's supports (the regions variant)

bow_root.label: The leaf's root block: where the draw pulls back (the regions variant)

sear_post.label: The sear's root post: where the cocked sled pushes forward (the regions variant)

muzzle_end.label: The barrel's end: where a knock lands (the regions variant)

column_top.label: The column walls' top: where a knock on the magazine lands (the regions variant)

outside.label: The grid's corners outside the outline, two cells clear of it: fixed for the solver, which otherwise crawls through near-empty space (the regions variant)
